tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "contract_price_not_yet_effective", "evidence": [{"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-006#11.1", "detail": "Addendum No. 1 dated August 26, 2026 changes the Black Laser Printer Toner unit price to IDR 842,400.00 only from October 8, 2026."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-006#2.2", "detail": "A unit price change takes effect only through a written addendum and never retroactively."}, {"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0039", "detail": "PO line 1 (Black Laser Printer Toner) is priced at 730,600 per unit for quantity 10."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "JOF/2026/00235", "detail": "Invoice dated 2026-09-24 bills line 1 at 842,400 per unit, before the 2026-10-08 effective date."}], "explanation": "Line 1 is billed at the new addendum price of 842,400 although the invoice date of 2026-09-24 precedes the clause's effective date of 2026-10-08, so the PO price of 730,600 still applies."}]}
